<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g fill="#18191F" stroke="#18191F">
    <text x="24" y="19" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F" stroke="none">9:41</text>
    <line x1="318" y1="14" x2="322" y2="14" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="12" x2="330" y2="12" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="10" x2="338" y2="10" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="14" r="4" fill="none" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="14" x2="351" y2="14" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="8" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="383" y="12" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#18191F" stroke="none"/>
    <rect x="363" y="10" width="15" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#18191F" stroke="none"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="106" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g stroke="#18191F" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5">
    <polyline points="42,78 32,68 42,58"/>
    <line x1="33" y1="68" x2="58" y2="68"/>
  </g>
  <text x="78" y="78" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="27" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Privacy</text>
  <line x1="24" y1="134" x2="366" y2="134" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="42" cy="164" r="16" fill="#E9E7FC" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M42 153 L50 156 L49 165 C49 171 45 175 42 177 C39 175 35 171 35 165 L34 156 Z" fill="#1947E5" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="70" y="161" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Manage your privacy</text>
    <text x="70" y="181" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Choose what others can see</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Setting rows shadow -->
  <rect x="23" y="199" width="344" height="444" rx="16" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.14"/>
  <rect x="23" y="197" width="344" height="444" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Row 1 -->
  <g>
    <text x="43" y="232" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Public profile</text>
    <text x="43" y="253" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Let anyone view your profile</text>
    <rect x="285" y="217" width="60" height="36" rx="20" fill="#00C6AE" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="327" cy="235" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="276" x2="347" y2="276" stroke="#EEEFF4" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Row 2 -->
  <g>
    <text x="43" y="306" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Show online status</text>
    <text x="43" y="327" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Allow connections to see when you’re active</text>
    <rect x="285" y="291" width="60" height="36" rx="20" fill="#00C6AE" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="327" cy="309" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="350" x2="347" y2="350" stroke="#EEEFF4" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Row 3 -->
  <g>
    <text x="43" y="380" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Discoverable by email</text>
    <text x="43" y="401" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Make it easier for people to find you</text>
    <rect x="285" y="365" width="60" height="36" rx="20" fill="#00C6AE" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="327" cy="383" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="424" x2="347" y2="424" stroke="#EEEFF4" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Row 4 -->
  <g>
    <text x="43" y="454" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Show activity history</text>
    <text x="43" y="475" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Display your recent work and activity</text>
    <rect x="285" y="439" width="60" height="36" rx="20" fill="#F4F5F7" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="303" cy="457" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="498" x2="347" y2="498" stroke="#EEEFF4" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Row 5 -->
  <g>
    <text x="43" y="528" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Allow direct messages</text>
    <text x="43" y="549" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Receive messages from new connections</text>
    <rect x="285" y="513" width="60" height="36" rx="20" fill="#00C6AE" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="327" cy="531" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <text x="24" y="674" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Changes apply to your public Contra profile.</text>

  <!-- Save button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="690" width="340" height="58" rx="16" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="24" y="688" width="340" height="58" rx="16" fill="#1947E5" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="194" y="724" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">Save changes</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <g stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2" fill="none">
    <polygon points="48,789 58,781 68,789 68,801 48,801" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="45,789 58,778 71,789"/>
    <circle cx="146" cy="788" r="7"/>
    <line x1="146" y1="799" x2="146" y2="806"/>
    <line x1="139" y1="806" x2="153" y2="806"/>
    <rect x="230" y="780" width="18" height="16" rx="3"/>
    <polyline points="234,796 234,801 239,796"/>
    <circle cx="239" cy="786" r="1.5" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="245" cy="786" r="1.5" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="789" r="9"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="785" r="3"/>
    <path d="M334 802 C335 795 349 795 350 802" fill="none"/>
  </g>
  <text x="58" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Home</text>
  <text x="146" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Work</text>
  <text x="239" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Messages</text>
  <text x="342" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#1947E5">Profile</text>
</svg>
